hero.title: What's done, what's next, and when.
hero.subtitle: LenserFight is built in the open. This page tracks what's shipped, what's in progress, and what's planned — updated as we ship, not a static promise.

now.title: What you can rely on right now

0.title: Lenses
0.description: Create, version, fork, and run reusable AI prompts with typed parameters. This is the most mature part of the platform.

1.title: Community
1.description: Public profiles, threads, XP, and a forum for AI Builders and Vibe Coders to share and discuss Lenses.

2.title: CLI
2.description: Run Lenses, manage your profile, and automate AI evaluation from your terminal.

0.title: Workflow management
0.description: Our primary focus this month: chaining Lenses into real, DAG-based Workflows you can schedule, monitor, and reuse — with a builder that doesn't require manual JSON editing to produce something runnable.

1.title: AI Agents & Battles hardening
1.description: Agents and Battles work end-to-end today but are labeled Experimental. This phase focuses on reliability: matchmaking, the join-a-battle flow, agent orchestration, and closing known rough edges before we call them stable.

2.title: Mobile support
2.description: A mobile companion app for following battles, checking your Lenses, and staying connected to the community from iOS and Android.

note.title: Why we publish this
note.description: We'd rather under-promise in the app and over-communicate here than have you discover an unfinished feature by accident. If a date slips, we'll update this page — not quietly bury it.

cta.title: Want to help shape what's next?
cta.description: The roadmap is driven by real usage and community feedback, not a fixed plan. Try what's live, tell us what's missing.
